purpose: Exposed historical development of an inactive-resale magnitude model; not untouched or current-market qualification

eligibility.economicIdentity: exact NFT contract + sale timestamp + native price; reject missing, duplicate or mismatched join
eligibility.targetPopulation: all feature-export rows in each evaluation interval; do not select attempts by realized price or venue for prediction
eligibility.trainingForResaleCandidate: only strictly earlier secondary auction or fixed-sale rows; label is completed historical USD sale
eligibility.trainingForAllStageControl: all strictly earlier completed-sale rows from the same feature export
eligibility.retrospectiveStrataOnly: actual USD cohort and realized primary/secondary venue may segment reports, never form target input or publication routing
eligibility.featurePolicy: frozen 118 structural/historical-snapshot semantic features plus 128 SHA-256 character n-gram indicators from username; no current knowledge, target price, realized venue, baseline price or vector-derived price
eligibility.repeatedIdentityPolicy: strictly prior sales may train; report repeated versus first-observed identity errors and identity-clustered uncertainty

model.family: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor on log historical USD
model.missingPolicy: fail on nonfinite prepared feature or label; no case filtering by outcome
model.modelSelection: no threshold or hyperparameter tuning on these folds; if this fixed recipe fails, record failure and design a new separately declared experiment

calibration: fit 10th/90th log-price quantiles on the same training subset as each center; on secondary calibration outcomes only compute score=max(lower-actual,actual-upper), choose sorted score at one-based rank min(n,ceil((n+1)*0.8)), expand both log-price ends by max(0,score); do not use evaluation outcomes
controls: same-target time-safe v25 baseline, with unavailable cases retained
same-target all-stage HGB fitted with the identical features and parameters
saved global-fusion point only on its exact overlapping exposed attempts, labelled a subset rather than a full control

reporting.attempts: every eligible evaluation row in each fold; report source-export coverage and any feature or baseline unavailability explicitly
reporting.metrics: paired mean absolute log error, median and p95 factor error, nominal 80% coverage, mean log interval score, abstentions and common-availability comparisons
reporting.strata: full feature-export population; retrospective secondary auction and fixed-sale; premium >=500 USD, intermediate [100,500), ordinary <100; first-observed and repeated identities
reporting.uncertainty: deterministic 2000-resample 95% paired bootstrap clustered by exact NFT identity
reporting.historicalViabilityGate: at least 100 secondary-premium identities across both evaluation blocks, secondary-premium MALE at least 25% lower than same-case v25 with positive lower clustered confidence bound, secondary-premium median factor <=3, ordinary secondary MALE no more than 5% worse, premium 80% interval coverage >=70%, no secondary-premium interval-score regression versus same-target all-stage HGB, and no availability regression versus v25; also report full-population regressions even if resale strata pass
reporting.qualification: failure or success here remains exposed historical development only; production still requires independently sealed prospective current-market validation and all existing integration gates

limitations: The feature export was selected as latest 30000 rows for earlier experiments, so this is not an unbiased full historical market census.
The 2024Q4 outcomes serve as evaluation in one fold and calibration in the next; folds are temporal development replications, not independent untouched tests.
Historical Dune labels have mixed on-chain trace coverage; a missing transaction hash alone neither proves nor disproves an indexed sale.
A model trained on secondary sales may still perform badly for unsold or illiquid wallets; no estimate becomes a guaranteed executable bid.
